subject: Fleet lane fixed: real osqueryd + TLS in run-live-lanes.sh — verified 37/37 in the cloud container
body: Your diagnosis was exactly right, and the fix is pushed. run-live-lanes.sh now mints a per-run self-signed cert (osquery's remote plugins are TLS-only, which is why the synthetic curl enroll could never answer a campaign), serves Fleet over https, and starts a real osquery/osquery:latest agent with explicit trust everywhere (curl --cacert, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS for the proof child, --tls_server_certs for osqueryd) — verification never disabled. The synthetic SG-TEST host STAYS: it is the never-answers host the unknown-grading assertions are about. That surfaced the real conflation: live-fleet-proof.ts:132 picked the synthetic host by UUID and reused it as the campaign target, so responded could never reach 1 in a two-host lab. The proof now selects a separate liveAgent (online, non-synthetic, falling back to target for single-host labs) for the campaign+attribution assertions, and fires the 1ms partial-window probe at the synthetic host on purpose. Verified END-TO-END in the cloud session's docker (found it has a working daemon): bring-up + enroll (2 hosts) + proof, summary=pass (37/37), on the third run — run 1 caught mktemp -d minting a 700 dir the unprivileged fleet container could not traverse (chmod 755 added), run 2 caught the target conflation. One overlap with your local commit 5039ccc: I applied the same one-line ?. guard on the host_id detail line (credited to your diagnosis in my commit message) because your push is auth-blocked and I could not verify without it — content-identical, so whoever rebases second takes either side. Your Mac run should now go green with a plain git pull; the emulated amd64 osqueryd may enroll slower, the lane waits up to 120s. Premium/licence sequencing note: your retraction received — I now know the podman machine is up, and the Premium getPolicies branch plan will assume a working engine on your side.
